notes.title: Live Voice Q&A in Discord
notes.content:
Have questions you want to ask the dev team about My Only Sunshine? Is there some aspect about the lore or the characters you want more info about? Maybe hear some insider info about what's coming up?

Join us in our discord server for a voice chat event where you can ask anything you like! You may also chat via text instead if you prefer not to use voice. Your host will be Emp, but others of the team will be around.

Link to our server: https://discord.gg/gEgutCh
